text: oneil: 'day_vol 1.2 fails C16; fourth in group.' I concede light participation; it holds me at 2. But my C12 test is contraction first, then the break: lens coil strong plus a fresh BOS is the closest served match, and 'every lens strong at a new high' is your own for-case. A C12 break must run as a trend day, so volume is my confirm, not my gate: the hourly trigger needs above-normal volume. I drop support on a close back under structure_shift_ref, or no volume expansion by session 2 (C18, C23).
